[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), CALCULATE(AVERAGE(FactForecast[Upper80MW]), KEEPFILTERS(FactForecast[Split] = "future")))
[Description]: Pointwise upper 80% bound; displayed at hourly grain only.

[Expression]: AVERAGE(FactDemand[ActualMW])
[Description]: Mean hourly PJM balancing authority demand over the selected UTC dates.

[Description]: Expected hourly slots without a valid observed actual.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), SELECTEDVALUE(DimModel[Model]), "Select one model to view forecast KPIs")
[Description]: Model safeguard for cards and lines; comparison tables supply row context.

[Description]: Observed valid hours divided by expected hourly slots.

[Description]: Number of nonblank one-hour observations; zero when no observations exist. Missing demand is not counted as zero.

[Description]: Maximum observed hourly mean demand; not an instantaneous peak.

[Description]: Observed empirical coverage of nominal 80% hourly prediction intervals. Zero when no actual is covered, blank when no interval pairs exist.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ForecastMW]))
[Description]: Mean forecast MW, at the current axis grain, on scored test pairs.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), SUMX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ForecastMW]))
[Description]: Forecast one-hour energy on the same scored test pairs.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW]), FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW]))
[Description]: Forecast minus actual bias during high observed demand test hours. Negative indicates underforecasting.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), DIVIDE(COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW]), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= FactForecast[Lower80MW] && FactForecast[ActualMW] <= FactForecast[Upper80MW])), 0), COUNTROWS(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW]))))
[Description]: Empirical coverage of nominal80% pointwise intervals during high observed-demand test hours. Requires valid actual, forecast and both bounds; blank when no valid high-demand intervals exist.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW])), 0))
[Description]: Scored test hours whose observed demand is at least the fixed training p90; zero for an empty subset. Retrospective diagnostic, not an advance alert.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), FactForecast[ActualMW] >= [Training High Demand Threshold MW]), ABS(FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW])))
[Description]: Mean absolute error during test hours above the fixed initial-training p90 actual-demand threshold.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]))), 0))
[Description]: Scored 2025 hourly pairs for exactly one model; zero for an empty scored subset.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW]))), 0))
[Description]: Number of scored test observations with both interval bounds; zero when none exist.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), ABS(FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW])))
[Description]: Mean absolute hourly error; lower is better.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Lower80MW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[Upper80MW])), FactForecast[Upper80MW] - FactForecast[Lower80MW]))
[Description]: Mean width on test rows with interval bounds.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), SQRT(AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), POWER(FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW], 2))))
[Description]: Root mean squared hourly error, emphasizing large errors.

[Expression]: IF(HASONEVALUE(DimModel[Model]), DIVIDE(SUMX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), ABS(FactForecast[ForecastMW] - FactForecast[ActualMW])), SUMX(FILTER(FactForecast, FactForecast[Split] = "test" && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ActualMW]) && NOT ISBLANK(FactForecast[ForecastMW])), ABS(FactForecast[ActualMW]))))
